name: Cubi Estate
description:
Cubi Estate is an AI-native property search engine for Europe. The connector gives Claude read-only access to a continuously updated corpus of 900,000+ active sale and rental listings across 14+ countries (Portugal, Spain, Italy, France, Germany, Belgium, Finland, Austria, Cyprus, Czechia, Croatia, Malta, Slovakia, Luxembourg), searchable in 7 languages.

Tools cover natural-language search ("2-bed apartment in Madrid under €400k with a balcony"), structured filtering, full listing details with source links, and day-by-day market statistics (new listings, deactivations, price drops, per country). Every result links back to its original source. All tools are read-only and annotated as such; nothing mutates data, and no end-user data is collected.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cubi Estate to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cubi Estate to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.cubi.estate/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Cubi Estate MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Cubi Estate scores 93/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cubi Estate MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cubi Estate provides these MCP tools: corpus_stats, data_layer_stats, filter_listings, get_listing, raise_stats, and search_properties.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cubi Estate?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cubi Estate in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Cubi Estate MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cubi Estate does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Cubi Estate is developed by Cubi Estate. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
